text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the autumn Tenno Sho has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Because of their strong wills, Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet have been able to walk their own paths without being influenced by the other's way of life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unwilling to give in, they put everything on the line and face off in this autumn's big race!
